question: What does the narrator refer to as the ‘turning point’?

options.text: He and his grandmother shifting to the city

solution:
The correct answer is '**He and his grandmother shifting to the city**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The seventh sentence of the second paragraph says "*When my parents were comfortably settled in the city, **they sent for us***'' (दूसरे पैराग्राफ का सातवां वाक्य कहता है, जब मेरे माता-पिता आराम से शहर में बस गए, तो उन्होंने हमें वहाँ बुला लिया) and the eighth sentence of the second paragraph says "***That was a turning point** in our friendship*'' (दूसरे पैराग्राफ का आठवां वाक्य कहता है, यह हमारी दोस्ती में एक महत्वपूर्ण मोड़ था)
 
• From the above sentence, we can say that the narrator referred to ''He and his grandmother shifting to the city'' as the 'turning point'. (उपरोक्त वाक्य से, हम कह सकते हैं कि कथाकार ने 'He and his grandmother shifting to the city' के रूप में संदर्भित किया है)

 

Hence, the only possible answer is option 4.
